name: ccstatusline-desktop
description: Your ccstatusline status line in the Claude Code desktop app: the same widgets, colours and settings, drawn in the band above the prompt.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the status lines are run again while nothing else refreshes them; a finished turn, a model switch, a compaction and a resized band always do. At least 5; 0 turns the timer off.

runtime.title: JavaScript runtime
runtime.description: The command that runs the bundled ccstatusline engine: node (the default), bun, or the full path to either when the app does not find it on its PATH.
